content_sections.heading: About IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate II
content_sections.text: The posts are advertised by the Research & Development Office of the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar. They sit in the EE department and serve the SAMARTH project, whose Principal Investigator is Nihar Ranjan Mohapatra. The notice describes the position as temporary.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice ticks "Institute norms" for eligibility; the "Funding Agency norms" box is not ticked. Candidates need one of the following essential qualifications: M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline. OR B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc. or equivalent in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 02 years of post-qualification experience. Marks: minimum 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in Class 10 and Class 12. Circuit-Level ESD & I/O Design: hands-on experience designing ESD clamp circuits or analog circuits, I/O diode networks, and ESD protection structures for standard and advanced technology nodes. EDA Tools & Workflows: practical proficiency in Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre/SPICE simulation engines and layout sign-off tools (DRC, LVS, Calibre PERC). Packaging & Parasitic: experience with chip-package parasitic extraction (R, L, C) and evaluating leakage paths considering package inductance and resistance. Layout & Tape out: experience in layout design, guard ring implementation and preparing analog blocks for IC tapeout. Testing & Characterization: practical experience conducting lab-based silicon characterization. The notice states that if the funding agency has eligibility norms, they should be followed. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration including HRA is INR 50,000 – 90,000, depending on qualification and experience. House Rent Allowance per month (if applicable) is printed as NIL. The appointment is for one year initially, extendable on satisfactory performance up to the project completion date.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate II Job Description
content_sections.text: The Project Associate II will be responsible for the circuit design, simulation, packaging-level modeling, physical layout, tape out delivery, and lab testing of ESD protection devices and I/O clamp structures. Key responsibilities: Circuit Design: design, simulate, and optimize custom ESD clamp circuits and diode protection networks to satisfy low-leakage and high-robustness targets. Technology Adaptation: adapt and implement ESD protection architectures across conventional and advanced technology nodes, evaluating transient breakdown and snapback behaviors. Packaging Simulations: conduct chip-package parasitic extractions and transient simulations to analyze current distribution and voltage overshoots during ESD transients. Layout & Tape out Sign-Off: execute physical layout of ESD cells, run complete DRC/LVS/PERC sign-off checks, and ensure timely delivery of clean layout blocks for tapeout. Silicon Testing & Characterization: perform ESD testing to accurately extract key ESD parameters. Failure Analysis: investigate post-silicon failure modes, identify current crowding or thermal damage, and document findings to guide future design revisions.
